report.explanation: Gateway traces show one ERROR span calling order (~1981ms), but gateway metrics/logs are healthy (error_rate 0.0012, p95 73ms, 200 OK). Order shows retained heap after GC (300MB, retained_after_gc true, 7 WARN occurrences), suggesting a possible memory-leak, but no chronological retention series exists and the deployment record alone cannot establish causation. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Chronological memory_retained_bytes series for order to confirm sustained growth versus a short increase
Order p95 latency and error-rate metrics during the alert window to link retention to the gateway ERROR span
Order logs/traces for the failing request to confirm whether the ERROR originates in order or a downstream dependency
Downstream (inventory, payment, postgresql) latency/error telemetry to rule out downstream-latency
